answer: Each agent earns a ripple of reputation points only when a vetted recruit proves work over a tundra‑length probation, and the system records the referral chain as a reef of immutable hashes. If a recruiter tries to flood the network with fake identities, every synthetic node must first purchase the same probation stake, so the cost scales linearly with the number of Sybil nodes. Consequently the attacker’s expense outpaces incentive, making mass spoofing economically prohibitive.
